altitude.description: Altitude (m or ft, per units), 0 to 10000 m (32800 ft). Lowers the surface pressure the math adds to gauge readings. Default 0.

cylinder_size.description: Metric: water volume of ONE cylinder in litres, the number stamped on the neck. Imperial: rated capacity in ft³ at rated_pressure (an AL80 is 77.4). Default: the preset's, else an AL80 (11.1 L).

preset.description: A common cylinder instead of cylinder_size, as in plan_dive: al80, al40, al63, hp80, hp100, hp120, lp85, s80, single_10l, single_12l, single_15l, twin_10l, twin_12l, twin_15l, stage_11l, stage_7l, o2_3l, dil_3l. twin_ presets are a manifolded pair.

rated_pressure.description: Imperial only: the psi the capacity is rated at. Default: the preset's, else 3000. Ignored on metric.

reserve.description: Reserve the cylinder must keep, as in plan_dive: rule thirds (default), fourths, fifths, sixths or fixed with fixed_pressure.

fixed_pressure.description: Reserve for rule fixed (bar or psi, per units). Default 50 bar (725 psi).

rule.description: thirds, fourths, fifths, sixths or fixed. Default thirds. Below 50 bar (725 psi) is always critical.

sac.description: Surface breathing rate, L/min (ft³/min imperial): the same figure as rmv_sac rmv and plan_dive gas_consumption.working_sac. Default 20 L/min (0.71 ft³/min).

segments.description: The profile in order, one entry per depth. Put descent and ascent time into the nearest segment.

depth.description: Depth of this segment (m or ft).

sac.description: This segment's breathing rate when it differs (hard work, a calm stop). Default: the top-level sac.

start_pressure.description: Fill at the start (bar or psi, per units). Default: the preset's fill, else 206.84 bar (3000 psi).

twinset.description: true for two cylinders on a manifold, filled or breathed together: doubles the volume. Default: the preset's, else false.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

name: gas_usage

cylinder_size.description: L of water (metric) or rated ft³ (imperial), one cylinder.

free_gas_volume.description: Gas the full cylinder delivers down to a gauge of 0, at the surface pressure for the altitude, real gas (L or ft³).

first_segment_below_reserve.description: 1-based segment that ends under the reserve.

first_segment_below_turn.description: 1-based segment that ends under the turn pressure.

minutes_left_at_last_depth.description: More minutes at the last segment's depth and rate before the cylinder is empty (no reserve kept).

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

turn_pressure.description: There-and-back: turn when the gauge reads this; half the usable gas is then gone.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

title: Gas use over a profile
